bd2550e2dc34.en: Open problems. <bookmark mark='a'/> Whether one-way functions exist, the assumption under all of Parts 29 and 30. <bookmark mark='b'/> A processor provably free of transient-execution leaks at low cost. <bookmark mark='c'/> Trustworthy automatic translation of C into a memory-safe language. <bookmark mark='d'/> And knowing what is inside the software we run, and who could change it. <bookmark mark='e'/> This part's research problem joins the last chapters together: a complete software stack, built up from a seed small enough to audit, every step reproducible, every translation proved correct, so that trusting it no longer means trusting anyone.
bd2550e2dc34.zh: 开放问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>单向函数是否存在，这是第29和30部分全部内容所依赖的假设。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个可以证明没有瞬态执行泄漏、而且代价很低的处理器。<bookmark mark='c'/>把 C 可信地自动翻译成一门内存安全的语言。<bookmark mark='d'/>以及弄清我们所运行的软件里面有什么，以及谁能改动它。<bookmark mark='e'/>这一部分的研究题，把最后几章连在了一起：一整套软件栈，从一颗小到可以审计的种子出发搭起来，每一步都可重现，每一次翻译都经过正确性证明，这样信任它就不再意味着信任任何人。

c23ddf4b9eae.en: Part 1 began with two piles of pebbles and one rule: if the piles differ, take from the bigger as many as the smaller has, and stop when they are equal. <bookmark mark='a'/> Twenty-four and eighteen became six and six, and six was the greatest common divisor, found by someone who knew nothing about numbers. <bookmark mark='b'/> That rule was an algorithm, and Hilbert's question, whether every such question could be settled by a rule, led to Turing's machine, and Turing's machine to everything this series built.
c23ddf4b9eae.zh: 第1部分从两堆石子和一条规则开始：如果两堆不同，就从大的那堆里拿走和小的那堆一样多的石子，两堆相等时停下。<bookmark mark='a'/>24和18变成了6和6，而6就是最大公约数，是由一个对数字一无所知的人找到的。<bookmark mark='b'/>那条规则就是一个算法，而希尔伯特的问题，是否每一个这样的问题都能由一条规则来解决，引出了图灵的机器，图灵的机器又引出了这个系列所搭建的一切。

0e22854a672e.en: Ten acts built one tower. <bookmark mark='a'/> Gates and arithmetic and memory became a computer, and pipelines and caches made it fast. Languages and compilers let us speak to it; algorithms told it what to do; and the limits of computation and the mathematics of secrets told us what it can never do and what it can keep hidden. <bookmark mark='b'/> A kernel let one machine run many programs; networks and consensus joined many machines; engineering, services and the cloud let people build on them at scale; and the last act looked outward, to pixels, numbers, quantum machines, proofs, and trust. <bookmark mark='c'/> Every layer rested on the one below it, and every one of them was built here, from nothing but the layer below.
0e22854a672e.zh: 十幕搭起了一座塔。<bookmark mark='a'/>门电路、算术和存储变成了一台计算机，流水线和缓存让它变快。语言和编译器让我们能与它对话；算法告诉它该做什么；而计算的极限和秘密的数学，告诉我们它永远做不到什么，以及它能把什么藏起来。<bookmark mark='b'/>内核让一台机器运行许多程序；网络和共识把许多机器连起来；工程、服务和云让人们能够在这些之上大规模地搭建；而最后一幕向外看去，看向像素、数值、量子机器、证明，以及信任。<bookmark mark='c'/>每一层都建立在它下面的一层之上，而其中的每一层都是在这里搭起来的，除了下面的那一层，别无所依。

a0f134394084.en: And the Job, counting the words of thirty novels, kept its ledger the whole way. <bookmark mark='a'/> Part 6's single-cycle Pebble took 281 seconds; Part 15's lambda-calculus machine took hours; caches, cores, compilers, algorithms, networks and services moved the bar back and forth across the axis. <bookmark mark='b'/> Row twenty is the plainest of all: one line of Python on this machine, about 1.3 seconds. Every layer of the series is inside that one line, which is the point of building the tower: so that one line is all you need to write.
a0f134394084.zh: 而那项任务，数出三十本小说里的词，一路上都在记着它的账本。<bookmark mark='a'/>第6部分的单周期 Pebble 用了281秒；第15部分的λ演算机器用了好几个小时；缓存、核心、编译器、算法、网络和服务，让那根柱条沿着坐标轴来回移动。<bookmark mark='b'/>第20行是其中最朴素的：在这台机器上的一行 Python，大约1.3秒。这个系列的每一层都在这一行里面，这正是搭建这座塔的意义：这样你需要写的，就只有这一行。

d77c6aa595f5.en: Six problems, with full solutions in the part's notes. Pause on any of them. The fifth is a build problem: hide a different trojan in our compiler and show that diverse double-compiling still catches it. The last, marked with a star, is a research problem: a whole software stack, grown from a seed small enough to read, with every step proved.
d77c6aa595f5.zh: 六道习题，完整解答在这一部分的笔记里。可以在任何一道上暂停。第五道是构建题：在我们的编译器里藏一个不同的木马，并表明多样化双重编译依然能抓住它。最后一道标有星号，是研究题：一整套软件栈，从一颗小到可以阅读的种子长出来，每一步都经过证明。
